title: Count of disjoint block choices
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $R$ be a finite subset of $\alpha$, and let $d,t\in\mathbb N$. The number of ways to choose, in order, $t$ pairwise disjoint subsets of $R$, each of size $d$, is $\displaystyle\prod_{j=0}^{t-1}\binom{|R|-jd}{d}$.
